overview_description.description: Circlys is a fintech established and operating in Saudi Arabia since 2017 is focus currently on providing public roscas (rotating credit and saving associate) for members who needed to join a circle and does not have private circles around then and its revenue comes from subscription fees based on the slot (month and value of contribution ) selected, it approved by SAMA (Saudi Arabia central bank) and has placed a strong risk-based framework to onboard customers with different risk profiles which might not profitable or targeted by traditional financial insinuations while keeping default rate within the industry average.

product.name: Circlys Application
product.description: A mobile application that facilitates participation in financial circles for various savings and funding goals.

product.name: Financial Circles (ROSCA or Jameya)
product.description: Digital platform for managing monthly financial contributions among members, where one member receives the lump sum each month.

product.name: Sharia Compliant
product.description: Ensures the application's operations adhere to Islamic Sharia principles.

product.name: User Authentication with NAFATH
product.description: Initial user identity and data verification through the NAFATH app.

product.name: Risk Department Review
product.description: Booking reservations are reviewed by the Risk Department to ensure members' eligibility and reduce fraud risk.

product.name: Manual or Automatic Payment Feature
product.description: Allows users to pay their monthly share manually or through an automatic payment system.
